source_facts: The actual 160-byte selector takes the parsed JSON value, tests object type, then tests presence of the root member sign.
The 16-byte predicate compares the native JSON type tag with object type7. The 32-byte presence helper returns whether the previously reviewed 284-byte member lookup is non-null.
An object containing root sign selects the original encoded branch regardless of the field value; sign:null is not plain mode.
Without root sign, the actual 1276-byte success wrapper keeps the document root, applies its existing response codec handling, then calls four common model updates and the endpoint callback.
The actual regular battle start/finish callback resolves to this exact same pinned 1276-byte wrapper; other families require their own source binding.
An absent HTTP date header skips the optional master-clock update; no server clock value is manufactured.
